_doc: PRE-REGISTERED CANDIDATE alpha — shadow-tracked daily next to the live baseline (tracking/shadow_log.csv, written by monitor --log). NOT live. The promotion decision must use ONLY forward data logged after freeze_date, per promotion_rule. Do not edit this file after freeze.
name: macro_mini
motivation: V1.8 Study 1 (docs/EXPANSION_STUDIES.md): pooled OOS IC +0.054 [+0.009,+0.099] — does NOT beat the ridge-2 baseline (+0.056) — but its RECENT-HALF IC (+0.087) was the strongest of any config vs baseline +0.054. That is a post-hoc subsample statistic picked from 6 scanned configs, so it needs forward confirmation before it can touch the live model.
promotion_rule: Evaluate no earlier than 180 forward TRADING days of shadow_log rows (~2027-05; n_eff only ~36 at horizon 5, so prefer 250d if patience allows). PROMOTE to INSTRUMENTS['ES']['alpha'] only if BOTH: (a) candidate forward Spearman IC > baseline forward IC on the same logged dates, and (b) candidate forward IC > 0. KILL the candidate early if its forward IC trails the baseline by more than 0.05 after 120 days. Evaluate with: python -m futures_swing.forward_validation --shadow
